description: Returns timesheets pending approval in the manager's team. Requires Manager role or above. Use when the manager asks 'show me pending approvals', 'who needs sign-off?', or 'any outstanding timesheets?'. Read-only -- this tool LISTS pending items only; it cannot approve them. To approve, direct the user to the DeskMonitor dashboard: https://thedeskmonitor.com/timesheets/pending

team_id.description: Optional team UUID to filter pending approvals. Omit for all teams visible to this user.

name: list_pending_approvals
title: Pending Approvals
